meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are survey estimates of people with a characteristic, not counts of legal problems or cases: a renter, a veteran or a noncitizen does not necessarily need a lawyer. Each estimate has a margin of error, and small counties' estimates are rough.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.

changes.title: First release
changes.summary: 3,144 counties, 51 states and DC, and the US from the ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates: 334,922,499 residents, 22,674,672 not U.S. citizens, 27,139,643 who speak English less than very well, 16,185,883 veterans and 45,017,354 renter households.
